title: Cancellation Terms Schedule, RentGuard HO-4 Tiers
content:
The cancellation conditions of the RentGuard Renters Policy take their periods and amounts from this schedule. The first three columns concern cancellation for nonpayment; the last four concern cancellation at the named insured's request.

## Cancellation for nonpayment

| Tier | Days past an installment due date after which a nonpayment notice is issued | Days from the notice to the scheduled cancellation date | Advance notice owed to a landlord listed as interested party (days) |
|---|---|---|---|
| RentGuard HO-4 Starter | 12 | 10 | 10 |
| RentGuard HO-4 Essential | 12 | 10 | 10 |
| RentGuard HO-4 Enhanced | 12 | 10 | 10 |
| RentGuard HO-4 Premier | 12 | 10 | 10 |
| RentGuard HO-4 Premier Plus | 12 | 10 | 10 |
| RentGuard HO-4 Signature | 12 | 10 | 10 |

All periods are calendar days.

## Cancellation at the named insured's request

| Tier | Return of unearned premium | Share of the pro-rata unearned premium kept on a short-rate cancellation (percent) | Minimum earned premium on a midterm cancellation (USD) | Most days a cancellation may be backdated to a documented move-out date |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| RentGuard HO-4 Starter | short rate | 10 | 50.00 | 0 |
| RentGuard HO-4 Essential | pro rata | 0 | 50.00 | 30 |
| RentGuard HO-4 Enhanced | pro rata | 0 | 25.00 | 30 |
| RentGuard HO-4 Premier | pro rata | 0 | 25.00 | 30 |
| RentGuard HO-4 Premier Plus | pro rata | 0 | 0.00 | 30 |
| RentGuard HO-4 Signature | pro rata | 0 | 0.00 | 60 |

## Schedule notes

- HO-4 Starter is the only tier returning unearned premium on a short-rate basis, keeping 10 percent of the pro-rata unearned premium; every other tier returns on a pro-rata basis with nothing kept.
- A backdating figure of 0 on HO-4 Starter means a cancellation on that tier is never backdated.
- A minimum earned premium of 0.00 on HO-4 Premier Plus and HO-4 Signature means no minimum is kept.
